job.prompt: Create an industrial platformer with moving machinery, dash, robot enemies, dangerous obstacles, crystals and checkpoints. Reach the factory exit.

events.detail: Validated typed design; composing sections and registered mechanics
Checking jump trajectories, landing margins and objective consistency
Runtime specification and asset dependencies persisted
Browser evidence identified a level route failure; reducing only gaps and elevation

model_design.json.title: Clockwork Core Escape
model_design.json.premise: Navigate the hazardous industrial foundry, evade rogue patrol robots, and utilize the dash ability to escape the automated factory before the core overloads.
design_notes: Used moving platforms to simulate active factory machinery.
Combined dash ability with wider gaps in the gauntlet section for high-speed momentum challenges.
Integrated crystal collectibles via thematic placement on industrial hazards.
